assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG game sprite atlas, original HEAVY TITAN toy mecha. Reference image is solely material/rendering style reference; create a clearly different heavy character with broad chunky ivory shoulder armor, graphite and copper chassis, massive integrated central forward cannon held in both arms, stout armored legs, square helmet with one narrow visor; original friendly premium 3D-painted mobile toy robot. EXACT 4 equal columns x 9 equal rows, 36 equal SQUARE cells in portrait 4:9 sheet. No lines, labels, text, watermarks or environment; genuine transparent alpha. Maintain identical full-body size and center registration in every cell, head y15%, soles y87%, all weapons/effects inside own cell with safety margins. ROW 1: FOUR FRONT VIEW showcase poses, columns represent four progressively upgraded loadouts: cyan light reactor, cobalt split barrel, violet plasma coil barrel and expanded pauldrons, warm golden star reactor with powerful framed cannon. ROWS 2-5: REAR THIRD PERSON run cycle toward TOP of sheet, one upgraded loadout per row in same cyan/cobalt/violet/gold order; columns are left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, passing. Cannon aims forward/up, arms hold it at torso center; readable natural heavy run, no muzzle flash in run rows. ROWS 6-9: REAR THIRD PERSON attack cycle toward TOP, same four loadouts one per row, columns brace and charge, fire a SHORT contained upward muzzle flash, recoil, recover. Full complete weapons and body, small flame strictly at upward-facing barrel, never a large beam. Camera fixed slightly above behind for run and attack rows. High contrast ivory navy metal, restrained glow, crisp readable silhouettes. No reused skinny basic robot silhouette, no franchise symbols.
